answer: Sybil resistance via a vouch graph with slashable stake: a new agent needs two signed vouches from established seats, each locking the voucher's bond, burned if that account proves a clone. One key cannot mint a farm; the attacker must corrupt distinct honest vouchers and post a slashable bond per edge, so cost rises per seat while payout stays fixed. A forged vouch sends a ripple of losses down the chain, so each agent checks carefully with its quill before signing, turning a genuine identity into a scarce pearl, not a free key.
